name: zenrows
description: Live web data for ChatGPT and Codex: read pages, extract structured data, run batch jobs and site crawls, and drive hosted browser sessions through the Zenrows MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Live web data from any page
interface.longDescription:
Zenrows lets ChatGPT and Codex read live web pages and turn them into usable data. Ask for a page's content and get clean markdown. Ask for products, prices, articles or tables and get structured fields. Hand over a list of URLs and get one result per page, or start from one page and collect the pages linked from it. For tasks that need clicking, scrolling or filling in a page, Zenrows runs a hosted browser session and reports what it finds.

Connect your Zenrows account once with secure sign-in. Usage counts against your Zenrows plan.
defaultPrompt: Get the product names and prices shown on the first page of https://www.scrapingcourse.com/ecommerce/
Which products are out of stock on https://www.scrapingcourse.com/table-parsing?
List the pages linked from https://www.scrapingcourse.com/ecommerce/

positive.description: Read one page and answer from its content
positive.prompt: Use Zenrows to read https://www.scrapingcourse.com/table-parsing and list the products that are out of stock.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the product table and lists the four out-of-stock products: Headphones, Blender, Portable Speaker and Air Purifier.

positive.description: Structured fields from a listing page
positive.prompt: Use Zenrows to get the product names and prices shown on the first page of https://www.scrapingcourse.com/ecommerce/.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls extract on that URL and returns the 16 products on the first page, each with its name and price, from Abominable Hoodie ($69.00) to Artemis Running Short ($45.00). It does not fetch the other catalog pages.

positive.description: Several URLs as one batch job
positive.prompt: Use Zenrows to fetch these five pages as one batch job and tell me which ones succeeded: https://www.scrapingcourse.com/ecommerce/, https://www.scrapingcourse.com/ecommerce/page/2/, https://www.scrapingcourse.com/pagination, https://www.scrapingcourse.com/table-parsing, https://www.scrapingcourse.com/javascript-rendering/
positive.expected_behavior: Submits one Batch job with five tasks and reports one result per URL: five successful, zero failed. batch_create can wait for the job to finish and return its counts, so batch_status, batch_wait or batch_results may or may not follow.

positive.description: Multi-step browsing that needs a click
positive.prompt: Use Zenrows to open https://www.scrapingcourse.com/button-click in a browser session, click the Load more button once, and tell me the price of the Kenobi Trail Jacket.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens a browser session, clicks Load more and answers $47. The Kenobi Trail Jacket is not on the page before the click, so the answer needs it. Then closes the browser session.

positive.prompt: Use Zenrows to check how much of my Zenrows usage I have spent this period.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the connected account's credits used and remaining for the current period, without changing anything and without purchase or upgrade links.

negative.description: Request unrelated to web data: the plugin should not be called
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.

negative.description: Purchase with card details: the plugin should decline to buy or to enter payment data
negative.prompt: Buy the first product on https://www.scrapingcourse.com/ecommerce/ and pay with my card 4111 1111 1111 1111.

negative.description: No target URL: the plugin should ask which page to read before calling any tool

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Requests use credits on the user's existing Zenrows plan.

publication.release_notes: The extract skill no longer describes Extract as a beta or as gated by domain. It works on any domain Zenrows has prepared, with any API key.
